claim_legs.durability: Tracked capture/reader/result and complete dependency identities; original native capture remains sealed. Filesystem times are immutable observation evidence, not a current-state claim.
claim_legs.falsify: Sealed raw native failure validation is independent of the log search. Hostile visibility/status/truncation/window/anchor/output/source mutations reject false promotion. A logging omission predicts the same empty query, so causal falsification is missing.
claim_legs.rederive: Authenticated original relay/stage bytes and their observed filesystem timestamps derive the exact saved command/window; complete query status/streams are retained.

guard_preflight.diagnostic: ram-guard: process-tree inspection is unavailable; rerun outside the sandbox or with process-inspection approval
guard_preflight.provenance: Agent-observed exec tool result; no separately captured native streams.

scope: Successful empty bounded host query for a filesystem-derived candidate window. No exact syscall wall clock, store-presence control or completeness guarantee for native failures. No original test, recurrence, tracing, privilege authentication or host change. Read-only OS log executable is a required external diagnostic dependency; all owned outputs remain repository-local.
